name: full-corridor-radius-line-v1
purpose: replace the small steering bias with a persistent safe-envelope outside-inside-outside path that materially uses track width as a local minimum-curvature proxy
hypothesis: On an obstacle-free bend, placing the vehicle at the safe outside limit before turn-in, crossing toward the safe inside limit through the sustained bend, and retaining the safe outside limit on the following straight will use more of the available corridor and locally reduce path-curvature magnitude relative to the v2 small-offset bias.

single_factor.name: persistent full-safe-envelope lateral anchors
changes: At row54, recover the complete contiguous asphalt run associated with the tracked road center, without the prior center+/-17 clipping, and use its actual midpoint and half-width as the lateral coordinate. The association window remains perception-only and is not treated as a wall.

Apply the same complete-run association at rows30,34 and42 only to correct the bend-phase geometry; otherwise a wide road can fill each center+/-17 window and falsely appear straight. If any tracked row is split so that its tracked center belongs to no unique asphalt run, do not substitute a corrected center for that row.

For the detected turn direction, set entry and exit targets to the outside safe limit and the apex target to the opposite inside safe limit. The safe limit is max(0,(right-left)/2-7.0), so the target never requests less than7.0 pixels of geometric center-to-edge clearance.

Construct a virtual road reference by translating the complete-run centers toward the phase target, and apply the frozen road steering gains0.016/0.012 to that reference. Do not clip the pre-slew reference relative to inherited centerline steering because doing so removes the requested lateral equilibrium on wide roads; every emitted action still passes through the inherited per-frame0.07 slew and absolute steering limits.

After a confirmed end of the bend, retain the exit outside target on the clear straight until the measured signed lateral position is within0.5 pixel of the safe outside target for two consecutive clear frames, then release to the inherited controller. A newly visible entry or any renewed/opposite coherent apex overrides exit hold immediately. Missing/ambiguous geometry, invalid road, current obstacle or obstacle miss latch still clears the line immediately.

Apex-to-clear requires two consecutive clear reads before changing to exit; a continuing apex cancels that confirmation. Entry-to-clear remains a false-preview rejection and returns idle after two consecutive clear reads.

Normally current-obstacle and miss-latch output remains exact to the synchronized completion shadow. If the vehicle is already at the7-pixel edge boundary and that shadow requests steering farther through the same edge, latch an edge-hazard guard: slew from the actually emitted steering toward the road center by the inherited0.07 step, emit zero gas and maximum inherited brake0.28, clear the racing-line phase, and keep that conservative recovery through the miss latch.
unchanged: rows30/34/42/54, bend threshold1.5, two-frame confirmations and generic camera-only geometry
cruise speed, target speed, gas, brake, obstacle detector, obstacle-side selection and miss-latch parameters
reset-synchronized longitudinal shadow and complete-action obstacle/latch fallback
model.pt, DrQ/export/HAIC paths, official environment files and all seed/track-independent routing

safety_priority: Track visibility and the7-pixel safe envelope are hard gates; any breach suppresses the racing-line target.
A near/apex geometry observation always takes priority over reaching the entry outside target, so an incomplete setup cannot delay turn-in on a sharp bend.

Current obstacle and miss-latch actions remain bit-exact to the reset-synchronized completion controller unless the registered edge-hazard guard detects that its steer would cross the already reached7-pixel boundary; line state clears in both cases.
The full-envelope target is a secondary objective only; inherited final clipping, slew, lost-road recovery and the synchronized longitudinal behavior remain authoritative.
No target is keyed to track id, seed, elapsed time, progress, memorized coordinate or evaluation result.

static: For mirrored left/right profiles, entry requests the outside edge, apex requests the inside edge and confirmed exit plus subsequent clear-straight frames request the original outside edge.
For span(31,52), the signed lateral targets are exactly+3.5,-3.5,+3.5 pixels and are farther apart than v2's+1.89,-1.05,+1.89 targets.

On a shifted straight located at each phase target, the virtual-reference steering request is zero; on a wide asymmetric bend it does not retain a centerline term that pulls the vehicle away from the registered anchor.
A wide or laterally shifted contiguous road span returns its real edges rather than center+/-17 pseudo-edges; disconnected asphalt not containing the tracked road center is rejected.
A wide synthetic bend whose clipped centers appear straight is still classified from the complete runs at rows30,34,42 and54 and receives the registered safe-envelope target.
At exact7-pixel clearance the correction is zero toward that edge; nextafter beyond the boundary suppresses the line rather than steering farther outward.

Apex clear confirmation is consecutive, continuing hairpins do not unwind, exit hold releases only after two consecutive at-target clear frames, and a newly visible opposite bend replaces the retained exit with the correct outside entry target.
Apex geometry switches entry to inward tracking even when the outside position was not reached, preventing setup from delaying a sharp turn.

Away from an edge conflict, all current-obstacle and miss-latch actions, pedals and steering state remain exact to the natural completion-control shadow from entry, apex, exit and clear-straight states.

At mirrored left/right7-pixel edge boundaries, an outward natural obstacle action activates the guard, does not move emitted steering farther outward, commands zero gas plus0.28 brake, remains bounded through the miss latch, and releases only after the inherited obstacle latch clears; an inward natural action remains exact.
Random mirrored actions remain finite, bounded, action-to-action slew-limited to0.07 on non-hazard frames and gas/brake exact to control; request-to-control delta is not used as a bound.
All affected/local-contract/submission-contract tests and an isolated exact-file package smoke pass.

abort: Any environment execution, training, submission, lap-time/completion claim or SOTA promotion occurs.

Any non-edge-conflict obstacle or miss-latch action differs from the synchronized natural control, any registered edge guard steers farther outward or emits gas/brake other than0/0.28, or line state survives a hazard.
Any requested target has predicted geometric edge clearance below7.0 pixels, any line frame bypasses inherited final action bounds, or any relevant regression fails.
Any speed, pedal, detector, obstacle parameter, model, official environment, DrQ artifact, user video or root submission.zip changes.

evidence.scope: These sources support minimizing curvature within track, vehicle and obstacle constraints. They do not prove that this perspective-camera heuristic is globally minimum-curvature or minimum-time; physical radius and performance require a later authorized controlled driving evaluation.

compliance_blockers: SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf remain absent.
Only source, synthetic, unit and package validation is authorized; the result cannot be promoted or submitted.
